plotSections.title: Separated Perceptions
bullets: The party remains unable to see one another, similar to what happened in La-rel, and most characters also cannot hear one another normally.
Physical interaction is still possible despite the separation: Ciri can strike Sylan, Sylan can touch Gerk, and vibrations through the boat can be perceived by nearby characters.
Gerk remains incoherent and unable to understand what is happening, making communication with him particularly difficult.

plotSections.title: The Spectral Door
bullets: A spectral, shining door materializes beside Sylan. It is closed, hovering in place, and appears majestic.
The door strongly resembles Gerk's door when his shield is in its door form, suggesting a possible connection between the phenomenon and Gerk's powers or role.
Sylan discovers that the apparent empty space around the door is physically occupied: walking around it causes him to bump into the invisible Gerk.

plotSections.title: Attempts at Communication
bullets: Sylan uses physical contact and then spells out a message with coins on the floor so the unseen party members can potentially perceive it.
The coin message reads essentially 'Hi Sylan' and is intended to establish communication while Gerk cannot help.
Ord considers using a powder or other substance to reveal invisible people, but the transcript ends while he is still looking for a suitable non-explosive material.

chronologicalEvents: The party realizes they are separated from one another in a manner similar to the previous incident in La-rel.
A tray of rolls suddenly materializes and falls onto the boat; Dana and Ord take rolls, while the party notices that objects can still disappear or be interacted with despite the strange separation.
Ciri tests whether anyone is physically nearby by blindly striking the air and eventually makes contact with Sylan.
Sylan realizes he has been struck by an unseen force but hears no corresponding sound.
Sylan hits the boat and discovers that nearby characters can perceive its vibrations even though they cannot hear the impact normally.
A spectral shining door appears beside Sylan, hovering closed and resembling Gerk's door-shaped shield form.
Sylan walks around the spectral door and physically encounters the invisible Gerk.
Sylan knocks Gerk on the head and Gerk remains confused and incoherent.
Gerk gives up trying to remain standing and falls to the floor, causing Sylan to physically catch/support him despite being unable to see him.
Sylan begins spelling a message on the floor using gold coins as a means of communicating with the unseen party members.
Ord considers using powder, flour, sawdust, or another substance to reveal invisible people, while avoiding anything explosive.

notes: Gerk is still incoherent and unable to understand what is happening during the separation.
Gerk cannot normally move during this phenomenon, although the DM allows him to fall to the floor.
Sylan can physically locate and support Gerk despite being unable to see him.
A spectral door appears near Gerk and resembles Gerk's door when his shield is in door form.
Sylan can physically interact with invisible party members and the environment even though he cannot see them.
Sylan discovered the spectral door and determined that it does not itself conceal a visible person.
Sylan used gold coins to spell out a message on the floor as a communication method.
Ciri attempted to locate nearby people by blindly striking the air.
Ciri successfully made physical contact with Sylan, confirming that unseen people can still be physically encountered.
Ciri can perceive certain physical interactions despite the party's inability to see one another normally.

Dana.existing: Half-elf cleric and most knowledgeable member of the group.
notes: Dana recognizes that the current separation resembles the previous situation in La-rel.
Ord attempts to find a powder-like substance that could reveal invisible people.
Ord considers flour, black powder, or other dust but specifically wants to avoid an explosive substance.
The current separation is explicitly compared to an earlier incident in La-rel where the party members were present but could not see one another.
A majestic, shining spectral door appears hovering near Sylan and Gerk.
The door is closed and does not appear to have anything visible behind or through it.
Its appearance is strongly reminiscent of Gerk's door-shaped shield form.
Sylan can walk around the door and physically encounter invisible Gerk, indicating that the door is not simply a visible representation of Gerk.
openQuestions: What is the relationship between the spectral door and Gerk's door-shaped shield form?

misTranscriptions.notes: Repeated variant of Sylan's name in the DM narration.
Multiple ASR variants occur while the DM and players are discussing Gerk.
The transcript says a tray of 'rolls' materializes, followed by references to a role disappearing.
Ord is discussing a powder or dust-like substance; the exact intended term is unclear.
Later discussion refers to the rolls that disappeared or otherwise behaved strangely.

openQuestions: What is the significance of the spectral door that resembles Gerk's door-shaped shield form?

newTerms.name: Spectral Door
notes: A mysterious hovering, shining door that appears during the party's separation.
It resembles Gerk's door-shaped shield form but is established to be distinct from Gerk himself.
